- ⛔ **Not here:**

  - the `spec-monorepo` root entry;
  - any source change in `src/**` of the three packages. A package whose errors turn out to be a real source defect, not a test shape, is reported for its own card, per the direction.
(stop on a breach outside these; explain in the report)
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: sonnet` (`dispatch-gates --tier`: no path-derived mandate, floor sonnet · default opus · ceiling fable). This is mechanical test-layer typing against a direction that names the remedy shape, with #18692 as precedent.

Thread-read: none
Serial constraints cleared: `No open PR touches the three packages or scripts/check-type-check-coverage.mjs (the file lists of all 21 open PRs were read in this act, main f8178ffece). In flight on this seat: #20620 (packages/cli migrate printer) and PR #21003 (#20825: packages/cli compile / validate / utils, packages/lint), both disjoint. area:devpath: #20620 is in flight, and its file surface is disjoint from this one.`

Taken 2026-10-01, `main` `f8178ffece`.
- **The premise, re-read on `main`:** the `DEBT` ledger holds `@objectstack/cloud-connection` (13), `@objectstack/hono` (3) and `@objectstack/observability` (11), and none of the three packages declares a `typecheck` script.
